saw_lines: Nobody buys a motorhome on a whim. They compare layouts and prices, then want a test drive before they sign.
So the sale is won or lost in the first ad, where a buyer chooses you or a rival dealer.
Your 2 live Meta ads carry no proof number, so buyers have nothing to trust. Collect one, such as reviews or units sold, and lead the next ad with it.
ads_1: Paid test: 69 € per day rental ad with a test drive invite
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram, Twitter and Youtube
